about: Global Boarders is a west Cornwall surf school and adventure centre with surf bases at Gwithian and Praa Sands. It also runs coasteering, sea kayaking and paddleboarding along the Penwith and Lizard coasts. The website says the business has rebranded as Makai and points visitors to makai.co.uk.
offers: Beginner, improver and advanced surf lessons
Kids' summer surf camps (ages 8–14) at Gwithian
where: Gwithian: Sunset Surf Cafe, Gwithian Towans, TR27 5BT. Praa Sands: beach car park, Castle Drive, TR20 9TG.
goodToKnow: Beginner and private lessons last two hours and include all equipment
You choose your location when booking online
The site shows Surfing England, RNLI, AALA and National Coasteering Charter logos
gaps: Rebranded to Makai, so the name and URL may need updating. What to bring and the cancellation policy were not stated.
